\documentclass{beamer}
\usepackage{tikz}
\newenvironment{tikzlayer}[1][]
  {\par\nointerlineskip\begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture, overlay, shift={(current page.south west)}, #1]}
  {\end{tikzpicture}}
\begin{document}
\begin{frame}{After a list}
\begin{itemize}
\item First
\item Second
\end{itemize}

\begin{tikzlayer}
  \node at (2,3) {Added};
  \draw (1,1) rectangle (3,2);
\end{tikzlayer}
\end{frame}
\begin{frame}{After text}
Some text here.

\begin{tikzlayer}
  \node at (2,3) {Added};
  \draw (1,1) rectangle (3,2);
\end{tikzlayer}
\end{frame}
\begin{frame}{After a display}
Text
\[ x^2 \]

\begin{tikzlayer}
  \node at (2,3) {Added};
  \draw (1,1) rectangle (3,2);
\end{tikzlayer}
\end{frame}
\begin{frame}{After a pause}
First.\pause Second.

\onslide<1->%
\begin{tikzlayer}[blue]
  \node at (2,3) {Added};
\end{tikzlayer}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
